components.name: Task-relative precision cardinalities under fixed correlated dynamics
components.project_addition: Hold one equal-width diagonal integer trajectory fixed while varying only the declared future observation language; classify two-coordinate integer-linear observables by coefficient symmetry, derive exact n-dimensional symmetric-sum, Boolean ANY/ALL, and equality future-state cardinalities, and record that scalar output dimension alone does not imply precision compression. The result quantitatively specializes P023 task-relative future compatibility: identical physical dynamics can require full dimension-power phase state, multiset state, or only one crossing bucket depending on the future query. Step functions, multisets, binomial coefficients, Boolean aggregation, and observational equivalence are established prior mathematics/computation; generic quotient theory remains P023-owned.
